title: Lucky Strike Entertainment Promotes Bobby Lavan to President and Chief Financial Officer
summary: Lucky Strike Entertainment Corporation (NYSE: LUCK), one of the world's premier location-based entertainment platforms, announced today the promotion of Bobby Lavan to President and Chief Financial Officer. Mr. Lavan, who joined the company in 2023 as Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer, will continue to report to Thomas Shannon, Founder, Chairman, and CEO of Lucky Strike Entertainment, and will assume expanded responsibilities for strategic execution and operational excellence across the company's portfolio. "Since Bobby joined us in 2023, he has fundamentally transformed how we operate," stated Mr. Shannon. "We brought Bobby in to drive growth and build the institutional infrastructure necessary for our next phase of expansion, and he has delivered on every front.
